release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.13 makes showdown value a stronger postflop decision priority. Thin and medium SDV hands must beat the passive check/call EV baseline by a meaningful margin before a bet can enter selection or high-level mixing. Thin value sizing is capped at 33% pot on flop/turn and 25% on river; medium SDV sizing is capped at 50% pot on flop/turn and 33% on river. Multiway SDV betting has stricter equity and EV hurdles. One-pair SDV raises require exceptional equity against the call-conditioned range. Protection bets are capped at 25% pot and must beat the passive EV baseline. Diagnostics report rejected SDV aggression candidates. The immutable 174-situation preflop chart remains unchanged.
